generatedFrom: Analysis of the PTPS clinic's Daten_SPSS folder (.sav data + .sps scoring syntax) and web research, 2026-07-02. See docs/legacy-system-reference.md for prose context and docs/target-data-model.md for how this maps onto the Instrument/Scale Prisma models.
howToReadThis: itemSchemaStatus tells you how much you can trust an entry to seed directly: 'complete' = item list + every scale formula verified against the legacy .sps syntax, safe to seed as-is. 'partial' = scale list and rater/population/cadence verified, but the item-to-scale mapping and/or exact formula was not fully extracted (too many items, or the source syntax file didn't exist) -- item ids are illustrative placeholders, not verified. 'not_extracted' = only the instrument's identity/purpose is known; item and scale detail still needs to be sourced from the clinic or the instrument's published manual before this can drive real scoring. Do not silently treat 'partial'/'not_extracted' entries as verified in generated code -- surface the gap.

instruments.name: Standarddiagnostik / Essstoerungsdiagnostik -- adult composite battery
instruments.abbreviation: n/a (a bundle, not a single instrument)
instruments.sourceNotes: Not a single instrument -- represents the bundle of BSI + BDI-FS + SIAS + PHQ-4 + IIP-64 + DERS + EDE-Q8 + IHS (+ full EDE/DEBQ/WBQ for the eating-disorder variant) administered together at each wave. Model this in the app as a 'battery' concept (a named group of Instrument ids due at the same wave) rather than its own Instrument row -- BSI/SIAS/PHQ-4/IIP-64/DERS/IHS component instruments still need their own catalog entries with item/scale detail sourced from their respective published manuals (Franke 2000 for BSI; Stangier/Heidenreich for SIAS-D; Loewe et al. for PHQ-4; Horowitz et al./German IIP-64; Ehring et al./Izadpanah et al. for German DERS; Forkmann et al. for the German INQ) before they can drive real scoring -- only their existence, rater, and cadence are confirmed here.

instruments.name: Standarddiagnostik -- adolescent composite battery
instruments.abbreviation: n/a (a bundle, not a single instrument)
instruments.sourceNotes: Bundle of YSR + BDI-FS + SIAS + TAIK + PHQ-4 + FRKJ + FEEL-KJ + EDE-Q8. FRKJ (Lohaus & Nussbeck, FRKJ 8-16, Hogrefe) has 10 six-item subscales (Empathie, Selbstwirksamkeit, Selbstwertschaetzung, Kohaerenzsinn, Optimismus, Selbstkontrolle, elterliche Unterstuetzung, autoritative Erziehung, Peer-Integration, Schul-Integration) all scored as raw item sums, high = more resources. FEEL-KJ (ages 10-19) scores 15 emotion-specific strategy scales (adaptive: problem-oriented action, distraction, mood enhancement, acceptance, forgetting, reappraisal, cognitive problem-solving; maladaptive: giving up, aggressive behavior, withdrawal, self-deprecation, perseveration; plus expression, social support, emotion control) separately for anger/fear/sadness -- item-level detail for both not transcribed. TAIK (adolescent alcoholism inventory) could not be confirmed against a specific published source.
